name: E4 long conversation remembers early decisions
turns: Build a G$ tip jar for the Grace Choir in Ibadan. Rules: the minimum tip is 20 G$ and the tip button must say 'Bless the choir'. Also, for later: any page we add must credit our director, Mrs Funke Adebayo, and we never use the word 'donation' anywhere (we say 'blessing').
Make the accent colour a deep purple.
Add a short FAQ with three questions.
Add a line under the headline saying we rehearse on Thursdays.
Show the total tipped so far in a stat card.
Make the browser tab title 'Grace Choir Tips'.
Add a footer that says 'Made with love in Ibadan'.
Give the FAQ cards more rounded corners.
Add an icon to the stat card.
Add a Robes Fund page with a second tip form for new choir robes, and an About page about the choir.
